# ebrary

> > A free online academic library providing open educational e-textbooks and college resources for learners worldwide.

ebrary is a digital library platform offering free access to academic textbooks and educational materials. The platform focuses on making higher education resources accessible to students through open educational content, with particular emphasis on accounting and business textbooks.

## Key Topics

- free e-textbooks
- academic library
- open educational resources
- online learning
- college textbooks
- accounting textbooks
- digital library
- educational content
- student resources
- higher education

## Getting Started

- [Academic library - free online college e textbooks](https://ebrary.net): ebrary homepage offering free online e-textbooks and academic library resources for students and educators
